ArtifactGeneration.description:
Content-derived identity of one coherent schema/function artifact pair.
It deliberately excludes the process-local publication counter: callers
learn these values from generated artifacts and can refetch them after a
deployment race.

CtxAnswerLedger.description:
The ctx-answer ledger (LLP 0051 D1): the ordered answers the deterministic
ctx surface gave during one invocation. Record mode produces it; replay
mode consumes it. Reads are never ledgered — `ctx.db` reads always
re-evaluate against the executing tier's current view; the ledger pins
*answers* only. This is LLP 0043 M2's captured replay environment as a
defined channel: LLP 0008 pins the client wire to exactly
`{generatedIds, now}`; the auth fingerprint is server-retained and never
crosses the client wire.

auth_fingerprint.description:
Fingerprint of the resolved auth context the handler observed
(LLP 0043 §Auth posture). Checked at replay when present: a mismatch
surfaces `SNAPBACK_AUTH_STALE_RESULT` rather than replaying under new
authority. Server-retained (D1 wire split) — record-mode outputs leave
it unset on client-bound surfaces.

ids.description:
Every host-generated id, in answer order (LLP 0008's `generatedIds`):
`ctx.runtime.id()` answers and `ctx.db.insert` row-id generation share
one ordered sequence.

now.description: The frozen invocation clock every `ctx.runtime.now()` answered with.

version.description:
Ledger format version, versioned alongside the shared data-tier
profile (LLP 0051 D5) so pre-extension ledgers stay replayable.

correlation.description:
Opaque adapter-stitched correlation (LLP 0034 §3.2, ENG-22478): the
Exact adapter's join keys (`actionInvocationId`, `optimisticWaveId`,
`rootId`, `bindingIds`) live inside. The provider echoes it verbatim
on receipts and never interprets it.

ctx_ledger.description:
Replay ledger (LLP 0051 D1): when present, the invocation runs in
REPLAY mode — `ctx.runtime.now()` answers `ledger.now` and every
host-generated id (`ctx.runtime.id()` and `ctx.db.insert` row ids)
consumes `ledger.ids` in order. Consuming past the end is a typed
divergence error. Additive: absent means record mode, today's
behavior. Queries and mutations only; actions never carry one.

MembershipWitnessEntry.description:
One held row in the witness: the wire row id (the same string
[`LiveDeltaWireOp::id`] carries) and the base64url (no pad) encoding of
the 32-byte LLP 0091 §0A.2 row hash the client holds for it.

MembershipWitnessWire.description:
The rung-2 membership witness (LLP 0091 rung-2 amendment / LLP 0090 Q7):
exact `(rowId, oldRowHash)` pairs for every row the client holds at the
token's version, in ascending UTF-16 code-unit order of `id` (the JCS
member order), with an explicit `count`. The keyed-leaf aggregate of these
pairs must equal the token's MAC-bound `contentDigest` root before any
replay is admitted; any decode ambiguity refuses to rung 3 and can never
suppress a removal.

count.description:
Must equal `entries.len()` — an explicit count makes truncation a
detectable decode failure rather than a silent smaller witness.

ResumeFromToken.description:
The optional `resumeFromToken` wrapper on the subscribe input (LLP 0091
§0B.4): token resume is not a new route. The wrapper carries the rung-2
`membershipWitness` (LLP 0091 rung-2 amendment, rollout step 5a).

membershipWitness.description:
Rung-2 membership witness (LLP 0090 D1.3): present only when the
client holds an `mset1` result within the size cap. Its absence never
refuses the resume — rung 1 and rung 3 remain available.

ResumeMeta.description:
Clear advisory copy of the token's identity fields (LLP 0091 §0B.1). The
client's digest-kind signal is `content_digest`'s self-describing prefix.

ResumeWire.description:
The RQS resume object (LLP 0091 §0B.1): the opaque server-authenticated
token plus its clear, client-advisory `meta` copy. `meta` repeats every
identity field the LLP 0090 D3 channel arbitration compares and is never
an admission input — admission decodes the token itself. Exported as
`live.resume-token.schema.json`, named distinctly from the reattach
operation's `live.resume.*` schemas (LLP 0091 §0B.4).

description:
Transport-only wrapper for optional call-time generation binding. Keeping
the assertion outside `LiveSubscribeInput` leaves internal/bundle-created
subscriptions on the explicitly unchecked compatibility path.

authorizationNamespace.description:
Store-owned identity for an auth-scoped live materialization (LLP 0096
§2.2, `authorizationNamespace`). `clientStoreId` is stable for the
durable store shared by every context that shares these bytes;
`queryKey` is that store's canonical function-plus-arguments key; and
`queryInstanceId` comes from a never-reused store-wide durable monotone
allocator (or a never-reused process allocator for live-only state).
It is ignored for explicitly authority-independent functions and
required in sessions mode for every other live function.

resumeFromToken.description:
RQS token resume (LLP 0091 §0B.4): not a new route — the token seeds
this ordinary subscribe. Admission per LLP 0090 D1.1; every refusal
answers with rung 3 (a fresh snapshot), never a subscription failure.

supersedes.description:
Explicit supersession (ENG-22478 review fix A): the kit names the
subscription its OWN resubscribe replaces; the server disposes exactly
that id. Plain duplicate subscribes (two components sharing a query)
coexist — supersession is never inferred from matching identity.
